facts.fact: Open Access Data Centres says the Uptime Institute awarded Tier III design certification to its carrier-neutral, open-access Isando facility in Johannesburg, which it describes as offering services to clients.
Open Access Data Centres states it has four Tier-III facilities and 30 edge data centres in South Africa, all open-access and carrier-neutral.

ZAF.note: Only an operator's open-access fibre claim; no capital-to-regions backbone stated.
A company's Uptime certificate; nothing on national standards.
Document does not state who owns Open Access Data Centres.
Nothing on links shared with another African country.
